# Exam Hunt Project: Comprehensive Architecture Overview

## Project Introduction

**Exam Hunt** is an educational technology platform designed to help students prepare for competitive examinations like NEET (National Eligibility cum Entrance Test) through intelligent question banks, adaptive practice sessions, and AI-powered learning assistance. The platform provides a comprehensive ecosystem for exam preparation with features including question browsing, practice sessions, test creation, progress tracking, and AI-powered tutoring.

### Core Goals and Objectives

- **Comprehensive Question Bank**: Digitized collection of previous year question papers (PYQs) from 2016-2025
- **Adaptive Learning**: Intelligent practice sessions with adaptive difficulty adjustment
- **AI-Powered Assistance**: AI tutor for personalized learning guidance
- **Progress Analytics**: Detailed performance tracking and insights
- **Gamified Experience**: Leaderboard system and achievement-based motivation
- **Multi-Platform Access**: Web-based interface accessible across devices

### Target Audience

- Medical entrance exam aspirants (NEET candidates)
- Students preparing for competitive engineering exams
- Educational institutions seeking digital learning solutions
- Self-learners requiring structured exam preparation

## Technical Architecture

The Exam Hunt project follows a modern full-stack architecture with clear separation between frontend, backend, and infrastructure layers.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[Frontend - React SPA] --> B[Backend - Spring Boot API]
    B --> C[MongoDB Atlas]
    B --> D[FreeLLMAPI - OpenAI Compatible]
    E[Nginx Reverse Proxy] --> B
    F[Cloudflare CDN] --> A
    G[AWS EC2] --> E
    H[Cloudflare Pages] --> A
    
    style A fill:#e1f5fe
    style B fill:#f3e5f5
    style C fill:#fff3e0
    style D fill:#e8f5e8
    style E fill:#fce4ec
    style F fill:#e0f2f1
    style G fill:#fff8e1
    style H fill:#f1f8e9
```

### Component Breakdown

**Frontend Layer (React)**
- Single Page Application built with React 18
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- React Router for navigation
- Custom hooks for state management

**Backend Layer (Spring Boot)**
- RESTful API with Spring Boot 3.3.5
- MongoDB for data persistence
- JWT-based authentication
- CORS configuration for multi-origin access
- Actuator endpoints for monitoring

**Infrastructure Layer**
- Docker containerization
- Nginx reverse proxy
- Cloudflare CDN and DNS
- AWS EC2 hosting
- Automated deployment via GitHub Actions

### Design Patterns

The project implements several key design patterns:

- **Repository Pattern**: Data access abstraction through repositories
- **Service Layer Pattern**: Business logic encapsulation
- **Controller Pattern**: REST endpoint handling
- **Factory Pattern**: JWT token generation and validation
- **Observer Pattern**: Real-time progress tracking and notifications

## Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points

**Backend Application Entry Point**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/ExamHuntApplication.java` - Primary Spring Boot application class

**Frontend Routing Configuration**
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` - Central routing configuration with nested routes for different sections

### Core Modules

**Authentication System**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/web/AuthController.java` - User registration and login endpoints
- `frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx` - Authentication state management with React Context

**Content Catalog Management**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/service/ExamCatalogService.java` - Exam and question pack catalog service
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/repository/ContentPackRepository.java` - MongoDB repository for content packs

**Practice and Assessment Engine**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/service/PracticeService.java` - Adaptive practice session management
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/service/PracticeAiService.java` - AI-powered practice assistance

### Configuration Approach

**Backend Configuration**
- `backend/src/main/resources/application.yml` - Environment-specific configuration with property placeholders
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/config/SecurityConfig.java` - Spring Security configuration
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/config/WebConfig.java` - CORS and web configuration

**Frontend Configuration**
- `frontend/package.json` - Dependencies and build scripts
- `frontend/vite.config.ts` - Vite build configuration
- `frontend/tailwind.config.js` - Styling configuration

### External Dependencies

**Backend Dependencies**
```mermaid
graph LR
    A[Spring Boot Starter Web] --> B[REST API]
    C[Spring Boot Starter Data MongoDB] --> D[MongoDB Integration]
    E[Spring Boot Starter Security] --> F[JWT Authentication]
    G[JWT Implementation] --> H[JSON Web Token]
    I[Actuator] --> J[Health Monitoring]
    
    style A fill:#e3f2fd
    style C fill:#e3f2fd
    style E fill:#e3f2fd
    style G fill:#e3f2fd
    style I fill:#e3f2fd
```

**Frontend Dependencies**
- React 18.3.1 - Core framework
- React Router 6.28.0 - Navigation
- KaTeX 0.17.0 - Mathematical notation rendering
- Tailwind CSS 3.4.17 - Utility-first styling
- TypeScript 5.6.3 - Type safety

### Integration Points

**API Integration Architecture**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Client
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant MongoDB
    participant FreeLLMAPI
    
    Client->>Frontend: User Action
    Frontend->>Backend: API Request
    Backend->>MongoDB: Data Query
    MongoDB-->>Backend: Query Result
    Backend->>FreeLLMAPI: AI Assistant Request
    FreeLLMAPI-->>Backend: AI Response
    Backend-->>Frontend: Combined Response
    Frontend-->>Client: Rendered UI
    
    Note over Backend: JWT Authentication
    Note over Backend: CORS Configuration
    Note over Backend: Cache Management
```

**Deployment Integration**
- GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipeline
- Docker containerization for consistent deployments
- Watchtower for automatic updates
- Cloudflare Pages for frontend hosting
- AWS EC2 for backend hosting

### Component Relationship Diagrams

**Frontend Component Architecture**
```mermaid
graph TD
    A[SiteLayout] --> B[DesktopSiteHeader]
    A --> C[DesktopSiteFooter]
    A --> D[Outlet Content]
    
    D --> E[DashboardPage]
    D --> F[PracticePage]
    D --> G[BrowsePage]
    D --> H[QuestionPage]
    D --> I[AnalyticsPage]
    D --> J[LeaderboardPage]
    
    E --> K[DashboardComponents]
    F --> L[PracticeComponents]
    G --> M[BankComponents]
    H --> N[QuestionComponents]
    
    style A fill:#e1f5fe
    style D fill:#f3e5f5
    style E fill:#e8f5e8
    style F fill:#fff3e0
    style G fill:#fce4ec
    style H fill:#e0f2f1
```

**Backend Service Architecture**
```mermaid
classDiagram
    class ExamHuntApplication {
        +main(String[])
    }
    
    class AuthController {
        +register(RegisterRequest)
        +login(LoginRequest)
        +me(String)
    }
    
    class ExamCatalogService {
        +getCatalog()
        +invalidateCache()
        +isExamAvailable(String)
    }
    
    class PracticeService {
        +createSession(CreateSessionRequest)
        +submitAnswer(String, AnswerRequest)
        +getSession(String)
    }
    
    class ContentPackRepository {
        +findByExamIgnoreCaseOrderByYearDesc(String)
        +findAll()
    }
    
    ExamHuntApplication --> AuthController
    AuthController --> PracticeService
    PracticeService --> ContentPackRepository
    ExamCatalogService --> ContentPackRepository
```

## Key Features

### Functionality Overview

**Intelligent Question Bank**
- Comprehensive PYQ collection from 2016-2025
- Subject-wise and chapter-wise organization
- Difficulty-level filtering and categorization
- Variant question generation for additional practice

**Adaptive Practice System**
- Intelligent question selection based on performance
- Adaptive difficulty adjustment during sessions
- Personalized learning paths
- Progress-based recommendation engine

**AI-Powered Learning Assistant**
- AI tutor for concept clarification
- Personalized study suggestions
- Performance analysis and improvement tips
- Interactive learning experience

**Gamified Learning Experience**
- Leaderboard system for competitive motivation
- Achievement badges and milestones
- Social sharing capabilities
- Community interaction features

### Implementation Highlights

**Advanced Search and Filtering**
- `frontend/src/utils/bankSubjects.ts` - Subject-based question filtering
- `frontend/src/utils/difficultyFilter.ts` - Difficulty-level categorization
- `frontend/src/utils/label.ts` - Question labeling and tagging system

**Real-time Analytics**
- `frontend/src/utils/analyticsDashboard.ts` - Dashboard analytics
- `frontend/src/utils/platformStats.ts` - Platform-wide statistics
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/service/ProductAnalyticsService.java` - Product analytics tracking

**Performance Optimization**
- `backend/src/main/java/com/neetlu/examhunt/config/PublicApiCacheProperties.java` - Public API caching strategy
- `frontend/src/api.ts` - Request caching and deduplication
- Cloudflare edge caching for improved performance

### Feature Architecture Diagrams

**Practice Session Flow**
```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> SessionCreated
    SessionCreated --> QuestionLoaded
    QuestionLoaded --> AnswerSubmitted
    AnswerSubmitted --> NextQuestion: Correct
    AnswerSubmitted --> NextQuestion: Incorrect
    AnswerSubmitted --> ReviewMode: Skip
    NextQuestion --> QuestionLoaded
    QuestionLoaded --> SessionCompleted: All Questions Done
    ReviewMode --> QuestionLoaded
    SessionCompleted --> ResultsCalculated
    ResultsCalculated --> [*]
    
    state QuestionLoaded {
        [*] --> DisplayQuestion
        DisplayQuestion --> TimerRunning
        TimerRunning --> AnswerSubmitted
    }
```

**User Authentication Flow**
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[User Registration/Login] --> B{Authentication Required?}
    B -->|Yes| C[JWT Token Generation]
    B -->|No| D[Direct Access]
    C --> E[Token Storage]
    E --> F[Protected Resource Access]
    F --> G[Session Validation]
    G --> H{Token Valid?}
    H -->|Yes| I[Resource Access Granted]
    H -->|No| J[Redirect to Login]
    I --> K[Activity Tracking]
    K --> G
    J --> A
```

**Content Import Pipeline**
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Admin
    participant API
    participant ImportService
    participant MongoDB
    participant R2Storage
    
    Admin->>API: Start Import Job
    API->>ImportService: Process Import Request
    ImportService->>R2Storage: Fetch Metadata
    R2Storage-->>ImportService: Metadata Files
    ImportService->>MongoDB: Store Questions
    MongoDB-->>ImportService: Confirmation
    ImportService-->>API: Import Status
    API-->>Admin: Job Progress Updates
```
